title: Sage rumble record
description: A rumble record (RumbleRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another rumble record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

low.description: The heavy, low-frequency motor at full strength (a thump, an explosion) Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 0.5)

high.description: The light, high-frequency motor at full strength (a buzz, a tick) Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 0.5)

duration.description: How long it lasts, attack and release included. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0.2)

attack.description: How long it takes to rise to full strength. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

release.description: How long it takes to fall to nothing at the end of the duration. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0.1)
